usedFor: Hostfully holds your rental bookings, and Razorpay creates a payment link when “New Booking” runs “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: A new booking gets a payment link with amount and expiry, ready to share with the guest.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” in Hostfully fires on every edit, so it would create another payment link for the same booking.
